name: Security 52
definition: Data specific to securities being subject to the transaction.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifier of the security subject of the transaction.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, that is common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

QuantityOrNominalValue.name: Quantity Or Nominal Value
QuantityOrNominalValue.definition: Quantity or nominal amount of the security or commodity subject of the transaction.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Price of unit of collateral component, including accrued interest for interest-bearing securities, used to value the security.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Market value of asset or collateral component.

Quality.name: Quality
Quality.definition: Code that classifies the risk of the security.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Classification of the type of the security.

ExclusiveArrangement.name: Exclusive Arrangement
ExclusiveArrangement.definition: Indication whether the borrower has exclusive access to borrow from the lender's securities portfolio.

HaircutOrMargin.name: Haircut Or Margin
HaircutOrMargin.definition: Collateral haircut, a risk control measure applied to underlying collateral whereby the value of that underlying collateral is calculated as the market value of the assets reduced by a certain percentage. |In the case of margin lending, collateral haircut or margin requirement, a risk control measure applied to the entire collateral portfolio whereby the value of that underlying collateral is calculated as the market value of the assets reduced by a certain percentage. |Only actual values, as opposed to estimated or default values are to be reported for this attribute.

AvailableForCollateralReuse.name: Available For Collateral Reuse
AvailableForCollateralReuse.definition: Indication whether the collateral taker can reuse the securities provided as a collateral.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|	/Identification Must be present| Or	/ClassificationType Must be present| Or	/QuantityOrNominalValue Must be present| Or	/UnitPrice Must be present| Or /MarketValue Must be present| Or /Quality Must be present| Or /Maturity Must be present| Or /Issuer Must be present| Or /Type Must be present| Or /ExclusiveArrangement Must be present| Or /HaircutOrMargin Must be present| Or /AvailableForCollateralReuse Must be present
